verdict.rationale: TruffleHog is a headless CLI binary that outputs JSON (`--json`) with verified/unverified status per finding, confirmed by a hands-on probe showing real JSON output with exit codes suitable for CI parsing (--fail flag), and supports filtering to verified-only results for scripting agent-driven issue filing. Docs also show routing findings to webhooks/Slack/Jira for automated action, and no account/API key is required for local headless use.
